answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by issuing each breeder a jade pedigree token whose ancestry chain is verified against a shared reef registry, so duplicated identities collapse onto one lineage. as meadow sown with distinct cultivars, agents stake collateral tied to their unique genetic marker, and colluders sharing markers are detected via kinship overlap.
